summary: Route 110 Camper Gavi revision-3 plan failed in the Eelektrik phase
symptom: The deliberate revision-3 retry exhausted all six party members while Camper Gavi's Eelektrik remained alive at 25/54 HP.

unexpected.predicted: Revision 3 was marked ready and expected to preserve enough Eelektrik-phase resources to reach Sunflora/Dustox.
unexpected.actual: Cufant entered Eelektrik at 56/56 and fell to 3; Staravia, Venipede, Phanpy, Grotle, Onix, and the remaining Cufant line were then exhausted. Eelektrik survived at 25/54. GPT whited out and auto-healed at map (0,1).
diff: Rock Smash dealt 8 and then a critical 14; Shock Wave dealt 22; Mega Drain could KO Onix.
Poison Tail triggered Eelektrik's Sitrus Berry at 28 -> 19 and restored it to 32, defeating the planned Venipede chip line.
The static evaluator did not provide a complete safe matchup model for custom Levitate Eelektrik.

authority.oracle: Battle RAM HP/species/PP, victory/whiteout text, post-loss map and party RAM, and checkpoint SHA-256

reproduction.command: Run the revision-3 Gavi plan from a fresh healed six-member checkpoint with canonical battle transactions.
steps: Verify Gavi identity and healed party from RAM.
Enter Eelektrik with Cufant and record HP/PP/species after each acknowledged action.
Compare the survival result with the expected-best plan and stop after whiteout.
reproduction.observed: One live run; not promoted as deterministic.

hypotheses: A dedicated full-health non-Ground Eelektrik counter with a reliable strong move is required.
The current generic evaluator needs matchup-specific samples and Levitate-aware candidate filtering before it can rank a safe line.

root_cause.claim: The current party and revision-3 plan lack a robust Levitate-Eelektrik counter.
evidence: Three unchanged-plan failures are now recorded.
Live Eelektrik-phase HP/PP and all-party exhaustion are RAM-verified.

solution.contract_change: Gavi readiness remains not_ready until a dedicated Eelektrik counter and a stable battle-action acknowledgement boundary are verified.
solution.workaround: Do not approach Gavi; use ROM encounter lookup and safe backtracking from the healed Slateport state.

replay.expected: Ready plan reaches the endgame with a preserved full-health counter.
replay.actual: All party members fainted during Eelektrik; no replay promotion performed.

domain_knowledge: Levitate makes Ground-based Eelektrik answers invalid unless the ability is removed or bypassed.
Eelektrik's Sitrus Berry and Mega Drain materially change chip-line survival.
regression_cases: Cufant Rock Smash versus Eelektrik observed damage 8 and critical 14.
Eelektrik Shock Wave versus Cufant observed damage 22.
Poison Tail 28 -> 19 triggered Sitrus restoration to 32.
tooling_contracts: Move-menu return is not an action acknowledgement when the queued battler can faint before execution.
Battle verification must require stable active identity, HP, PP, and drained battle text.

action_changing_unknowns: Which reachable ROM encounter provides a full-health non-Ground Eelektrik counter with sufficient neutral or super-effective damage?
Whether the battle verifier can reliably distinguish a stale move menu from a command-menu acknowledgement after a queued turn.
Whether the new counter also covers Sunflora and Dustox without consuming the Eelektrik reserve.

next_experiments.hypothesis: The ROM encounter index exposes a reachable species that survives Eelektrik and has a reliable non-Ground answer.
next_experiments.action: Query visited-only wild encounters and score candidates by type, legal moves, bulk, and level-cap training cost.
next_experiments.expected_discriminator: At least one candidate has a safe, verifiable Eelektrik line and does not rely on Ground damage.
next_experiments.rollback: No game mutation; keep the live healed state unchanged.

next_experiments.hypothesis: The verifier race can be closed by requiring a stable command menu after move resolution.
next_experiments.action: Replay the saved transaction fixture on a copy and compare move PP/active identity across two stable RAM observations.
next_experiments.expected_discriminator: The stale move-menu and misclassified party-switch states become explicit unresolved outcomes instead of false verification.
next_experiments.risk: Replay copy only; do not mutate live progress.
next_experiments.cost: Bounded emulator replay and focused tests.
next_experiments.rollback: Restore the newest live checkpoint after the probe and verify its hash.
